name: Hỏa hổ lướt
desc: a dash wrapped in a charging fire tiger: a white-hot beast head with an open maw, ears and a flaming mane leads the dash; behind it flame tongues lick up and back, cooling from yellow to orange to red as they are left behind, lift, tear and scatter red flecks; long yellow streaks trail the head while it is fast; grey and light-grey layers (ground haze, toon smoke with swept tails, a dust kick at the start, wind shards, a swoosh arc, dark speed lines) give it weight; at the end the head bursts forward into flame
